notes: Crisis cases for the precomputed advisor artifacts. Asset ids follow contracts.md for PGLib networks (branch-<row>, gen-<row>, bus-<BUS_I>, load-<BUS_I>). Every case starts from the AC-OPF operating point of the intact network (operating_point=opf) because PGLib case files store Pg values that are not a feasible dispatch. Cases were chosen from an AC N-1 / generator-outage screen of that operating point.
